reigns.note: Prince of Teuthrania, the old name of the country where Pergamon later stood.
Succeeded Teuthras as king of the Mysians after Delphi revealed his parentage.
Despot of Teuthrania when the Aeacid line returned to the Caicus plain long after Telephus.
Son of Neoptolemus and Andromache; slew Areius in single combat and gave his name to the city.
